{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -eu
mkdir -p temp_check
# Raw capture
{
  declare -p var 2>/dev/null || echo "var: (unset)"
  printf 'RAW_VALUE_BEGIN\n'
  printf '%s' "${var-}"
  printf '\nRAW_VALUE_END\n'
  printf 'ENV_ENTRY:\n'
  env | grep -E '^var=' || true
  printf 'LENGTH:%s\n' "${#var-}"
} > temp_check/var_raw.txt

# normalized
raw="${var-}"
trimmed="$(printf '%s' "$raw" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"
# canonicalization
canonical="$(printf '%s' "$trimmed" | awk '{
  s=$0
  if (s ~ /^[+-]?[0-9]+$/) {
    neg = (s ~ /^-/)
    gsub(/^[+-]/,"",s)
    sub(/^0+/,"",s)
    if (s=="") s="0"
    if (neg) s = "-" s
    print s
  } else {
    print s
  }
}')"
printf '%s\n' "$trimmed" > temp_check/var_normalized.txt
printf '%s\n' "$canonical" >> temp_check/var_normalized.txt

# conversion using python
convfile=temp_check/var_conversion.txt
python3 - <<PY > "$convfile" 2>&1
import sys
s = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else ''
s = s
try:
    n = int(s)
    print("status: ok")
    print("canonical:", n)
    sys.exit(0)
except Exception as e:
    print("status: error")
    print("error:", e)
    sys.exit(1)
PY "$canonical" || true

# check declare -p for -i attr
has_int_attr=0
if declare -p var 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'declare \-i'; then has_int_attr=1; fi

# conversion success?
if grep -q '^status: ok' "$convfile"; then conv_ok=1; else conv_ok=0; fi
# set verification
verification=false
explain=""
if [ "$conv_ok" -eq 1 ]; then
  if [ "$has_int_attr" -eq 1 ]; then
    # compare var trimmed to canonical (string)
    if [ "$(printf '%s' "$trimmed")" = "$(awk -F': ' '/^canonical:/ {print $2}' "$convfile")" ]; then
      verification=true
      explain="variable had integer attribute and conversion matches textual value"
    else
      verification=false
      explain="variable had integer attribute but conversion differs from textual value"
    fi
  else
    verification=true
    explain="conversion succeeded and value is integer-like"
  fi
else
  if [ "$has_int_attr" -eq 1 ]; then
    verification=false
    explain="variable has integer attribute but conversion failed"
  else
    verification=false
    explain="conversion failed; value is not integer-like"
  fi
fi

printf 'verification: %s\nnote: %s\n' "$verification" "$explain" > temp_check/var_verification.txt

# Clean up: remove normalized file if exists
rm -f temp_check/var_normalized.txt

# create ready_for_decision
printf 'verification: %s\nexplanation: %s\nkey_evidence_file: var_raw.txt, var_conversion.txt, var_verification.txt\n' "$verification" "$explain" > temp_check/ready_for_decision.txt

# final decision: is var integer?
if [ "$verification" = "true" ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
